chunks: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, the cows look alike to us, and indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided."
ai.seo_question: What did Bani Israel say when asked to identify the specific cow?
ai.summary: This verse captures the Israelites' progressive reluctance, shifting from simple obedience to demanding specific details to avoid ambiguity, a trait Shia scholars often link to their tendency toward *ta'assuf* (excessive detail-seeking) to delay the command. The mention of 'if God wills' (*in sha' Allah*) highlights their conditional acceptance, contrasting with the immediate compliance expected of prophets. This narrative serves as a critique of how literalism can obscure the spiritual essence of divine commands.
